payload.design_summary: KA-001 establishes the Watchtower backend event substrate by using the shared run_conversation finalizer. It emits a compact, redacted, profile-scoped JSONL row only when watchtower.enabled and audit_log are true. The row is explicitly provisional: event_stage=turn_finalized_raw, provisional=true, notification_ready=false. This deliberately stops before fleet registry, debounce, Feishu renderer, interactive cards, or archive policy, so the first review can verify lifecycle facts without product-surface false claims.

dispatch_policy.reason: Reviewer Spec Audit passed/warned; bridge normalized PM's pre-audit dispatch baton and now lets deterministic Spec Gate decide Executor dispatch.

event_schema_contract.downstream_guardrail: KA-001 JSONL rows are audit inputs only. Later registry/snapshot/notification KAs must transform and verify them before treating any state as notification-ready.
event_schema_contract.identity_provenance_rule: session_id/profile/source/title_or_unknown must be produced from backend session/agent context when available; if unavailable, write the literal unknown or equivalent explicit unknown marker. Do not infer or guess identity.

evidence_required: git diff for allowed files only
sanitized temp JSONL sample event containing event_stage/provisional/notification_ready/session identity fields
explicit separation: backend detected, audit written, notification_ready=false
explicit non-claims: no Feishu delivery, no registry, no debounce, no card buttons, no archive policy, no product acceptance, no KR closure

failure_routes.route: Executor writes failure details to evidence; Reviewer returns REJECTED or NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.
If implementation needs forbidden files or Feishu/TUI changes, stop and ask PM for a new KA/rework spec.
If current uncommitted watchtower prototype conflicts with this spec, preserve evidence and request PM decision; do not silently overwrite unrelated work.
If evidence proves only a helper/prototype rather than Hermes backend finalizer path, mark partial and route to rework.
If code or evidence treats the KA-001 event as notification-ready or final Watchtower state, block/rework until event_stage/provisional/notification_ready semantics are explicit.
If session_id/profile/source/title_or_unknown cannot be produced without guessing, write explicit unknown markers or request rework; do not invent identity.
If finalizer integration test is impractical in this slice, provide module tests plus gap note for Reviewer to decide rework.

non_goals: Do not implement notification-ready fleet snapshot.
Do not implement debounce/rate limit/retry queue.
Do not implement interactive card/button callbacks.
Do not implement archive policy or auto-archive.
Do not claim product acceptance, production readiness, KR closure, Spec Gate pass, or KA verification.
payload.objective: 在 Hermes turn-finalized 阶段建立 profile-scoped provisional JSONL 审计事实源，为后续 Fleet Registry / notification-ready snapshot / Feishu 接力通知打地基；本 KA 不提供通知就绪能力。

adopted: Treat KA-001 JSONL event as a provisional lifecycle audit event, not a final Watchtower notification snapshot.
Add explicit event_stage/provisional/notification_ready semantics so downstream KAs cannot confuse this event with notification readiness.
Make session identity/provenance mandatory: session_id/profile/source/title_or_unknown must be stable or explicitly unknown; guessing is forbidden.
Keep finalizer-first backend slice instead of expanding into TUI/CLI/Feishu hooks.
product_architecture_resolution.minimal_visible_loop_for_this_ka: Backend lifecycle event is written to profile-scoped JSONL and exposed through executor evidence as a reviewable artifact; this is not a live Feishu notification loop.
rejected_or_deferred: Direct Feishu delivery, interactive cards, registry aggregation, debounce, buttons, archive policy, GUI/DOM monitoring are deferred out of KA-001.
product_architecture_resolution.zizi_decision: 第一阶段必须留下最小可见产品闭环。

requirements.requirement: Provide a stable TurnFinalizedLifecycleEvent schema with event_id, schema_version, event_stage, provisional, notification_ready, session_id, task_id, turn_id, profile, source, title_or_unknown, previous_state, new_state, status, turn_exit_reason, completed, failed, interrupted, event_at, duration_ms, final_response_excerpt, evidence_summary, requires_human, action_needed, confidence, metadata.

requirements.requirement: Normal completed turns must map to checkout_needed and requires_human=true, but checkout_needed is only a provisional audit state, not final product/notification readiness.
requirements.verification_method: Pytest completed turn mapping asserts checkout_needed/requires_human while notification_ready=false.

requirements.requirement: Every event must encode event_stage=turn_finalized_raw, provisional=true, and notification_ready=false or exact equivalent semantics.
requirements.verification_method: Pytest field assertions and sample JSONL include event_stage/provisional/notification_ready.

requirements.requirement: session_id/profile/source/title_or_unknown must be stable or explicitly unknown; do not guess provenance.
requirements.verification_method: Pytest covers populated context and explicit unknown fallback cases.

requirements.requirement: failed/partial/empty final_response maps to failed; interrupted maps to interrupted.
Redact secret-like strings from final_response_excerpt, evidence_summary, and nested metadata/guardrail before writing.
requirements.verification_method: Pytest serializes event and searches for original secret-like substrings.

requirements.requirement: emit_turn_finalized_event and append_jsonl_event must fail open: log/return false, never break final response delivery.
requirements.verification_method: Pytest simulates write failure/hook exception and asserts caller result is preserved.

requirements.requirement: Tests must use temp HERMES_HOME/config and must not touch real ~/.hermes.
requirements.verification_method: Test fixtures monkeypatch HERMES_HOME/config; evidence must not point to real profile writes.

requirements.requirement: Executor evidence must clearly separate backend detected, audit written, and notification_ready=false; it must not imply Feishu delivery/product acceptance.
requirements.verification_method: Executor evidence file must include explicit backend/audit/notification non-claims.
